scope: Primary-method resolution for force-only TR12/NDS references, current local pressure/shaft thresholds, and the unresolved complete wrench/group criterion. No candidate acceptance is recorded.

TR12_example_3_1_control.use: Published equation known-answer only; no Candidate13 forces are transferred.

AWC_TR12_2015.title: General Dowel Equations for Calculating Lateral Connection Values

TR12_NDS_six_mode.supported_scope: Two-member single-shear connection under a single lateral-translation resultant, with all six P_i/R_di modes, valid D/Dr, gap, grain and material inputs.
TR12_NDS_six_mode.factor_five_result: Because each lateral-mode R_d is at most 5 in this scope, min(P_i)/5 is a conservative lower envelope for min(P_i/R_di) for that same pure-translation problem.

current_force_only_result.scenario: G=0.50 and generic Fyb=45 ksi; unadopted

TR12_NDS_six_mode.three_media_boundary: The force-only TR12 output excludes all 20 three-media axes, including eoere_bolt_067/070 and v10_header_bolt_001/004. Do not transfer the two-member translation check to those stacks. The 552 conditional rows do not include free-couple interaction, actual Cg/Cdelta, or complete acceptance.

method_dispositions.Hankinson_and_4Ktheta: NDS §§12.3.3–12.3.4 and Table 12.3.1B support Fe(theta) and 4Ktheta for the Im/Is wood-bearing reference. This supports the stored local pressure threshold on the constructed fields; 4Ktheta is not a universal factor or the complete six-mode minimum.
method_dispositions.pure_fastener_bending: TR12 Mds=Fyb*D^3/6 is an ideal plastic hinge input to the lateral yield equations. The stored M_upper<=Fyb*D^3/30 comparison is a conditional pure-bending screen with an added divisor five; NDS/TR12 do not prescribe that divisor for an arbitrary full wrench moment.
method_dispositions.same_section_VM_divisor_5: No NDS/TR12 provision was identified for the stored Fyb/5 von Mises interaction. Its threshold is exactly five times the stored nominal section VM stress envelope. Fyb is a bending-yield property, distinct from tensile Fy; the divisor-five result is a declared comparison only.
method_dispositions.possible_shaft_only_alternative: The stored conservative circular-shaft stress envelope can be compared separately with product-supported tensile Fy under an expressly adopted isotropic von Mises model and verified loaded sections. This is a conditional shaft-material reference, not an NDS connection capacity and not a check of threads/notches, wood, washers, heads, nuts, fittings, or group behavior.
method_dispositions.group_and_lower_bound: NDS §11.1.2 local-stress mechanics checks do not themselves replace §11.3.6 group-action treatment. The current statically closed per-axis fields preserve forces and couples but do not supply a complete source-supported six-component yield surface/load-path criterion or a physical NDS row/slip mapping. No Cg=1, Cdelta=1, or 1/n acceptance is adopted.

exact_missing_inputs: Product/size/lot-specific Fyb evidence under NDS §12.3.6.2: ASTM F1575 bending test, or ASTM F606 with an explicit supported tensile-to-Fyb evaluation. Do not infer Fyb from a grade label or substitute Fy.

For the optional isotropic von Mises shaft reference, product-supported minimum tensile Fy and delivered loaded body/root/thread/runout geometry; current shaft profiles are unverified and omit notch/head/nut stress concentrations.

Actual wood species, grade, specific gravity, Fe(theta), and grain direction at each host; actual plywood product/layup/face-grain and bond continuity at 067/070. Current G=0.50 and panel values are conditional.
Actual steel angle/plate product and minimum Fu for the local pressure-only thresholds, together with fitting resistance and contact geometry.

A supported complete local wrench criterion for axial/lateral forces, torsion and signed free couples across all contact paths; wood splitting/tearout/edge/end, washer/head/nut, and steel fitting modes remain separate.
A qualifying physical NDS fastener-row/group assignment and required group-slip inputs, or a separately supported complete mechanics method. Unequal FE bolt forces alone do not waive Cg/Cdelta.
